info.title: Campbooks admin API
info.description: Instance administration. Every operation answers 404 (as for a route that does not exist) unless the caller is a user whose bearer token carries the `admin:access` scope and whose admin profile grants the operation's permission (`x-campbooks-admin.permission`; `super` grants all). Then a token whose last sign-in (`auth_time`) is more than 12 hours old answers 401 `admin_reauth_required`. Every request past the profile check is recorded in the audit trail. These operations are not part of the operation catalogue (`/openapi.json`): automation and the assistant cannot call them. Admin profiles are managed only with the server's CLI (`campbooks-server admin`), never over HTTP. The web app reaches this API through `/bff/admin/*`.
